children: It's been a bad month for Micron stock but the tide might finally turning when it comes to artificial-intelligence sentiment.

The shares rose 2.4% to $917.52 Wednesday, having fallen 16% in October through Tuesday's close. If the gains hold it would be just the fifth positive day for Micron all month — remarkable for a stock that has risen more than 200% this year.
SpaceX earnings and a bullish update from AI server maker Super Micro Computer were helping breathe new life into the AI trade Wednesday.

Super Micro hiked its revenue guidance for the fiscal first quarter to between $18.5 billion and $19.5 billion, up from a previous range of $14.5 billion to $15.5 billion. The stock jumped 10% on Wednesday.
SpaceX was up 8.4% after its strong earnings — and, significantly, the company flagged a huge spending splurge, planning to spend up to $40 billion in the fourth quarter.
That's great new for AI stocks. Micron may not be among the biggest risers Wednesday, but it was a welcome boost after a tough few weeks.
